latest_cos_commentary.headline: sunday is a fast-growing QR-code pay-at-table and AI ordering platform operating in the US, France, and UK, with 5,000+ restaurant customers and named clients including Lettuce Entertain You and Boka Restaurant Group.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Direct competitor to Genius on tableside pos/payments and digital_menu_boards-adjacent AI ordering/menu features, particularly in full-service and hospitality-group accounts.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Has built meaningful press visibility (self-reported coverage in Forbes, Fortune, TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Fast Company, Wired, and Yahoo Finance) and multi-country presence, indicating an actively scaling competitor in the pay-at-table category.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where a full-service or hospitality-group prospect already runs sunday for pay-at-table, understand it is a QR/contactless-first product rather than a full POS replacement, and probe whether they are also evaluating it for AI menu/ordering features.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Leadership and specific funding-round details were not verified; transaction-volume and ROI figures are vendor-reported aggregates, not independently audited.
